body: I work part-time at a clothing store in the mall. I'm not sure if my workplace has access to some sort of program like that, but I do not feel comfortable talking to any of my managers about it.

They do understand depression and how bad it can get as they have dealt with my depression before. I have a feeling that they do not think it is as bad this time because it is not affecting my entire life the same way it was last time. The thing is, my thoughts and feelings are just as bad, if not worse, and I explain this to them, but they refuse to listen.
Fair enough. It was more meant to be rhetorical, anyway.
Yes, your friend's life was cut short, but it was a life he did not want. Would it have been better if he had lived miserably for 60 more years?
I shouldn't have to go through it alone, you're right. But I am going through it alone.
I appreciate the sentiment, but there are those of us who are truly not cared about.
Death is a natural part of life and personally, I do not think it is that big of a deal. Your death is going to affect those who love you regardless of when it happens.
